mapper.select: SELECT target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, skill_id AS skillId, enabled, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.skill_mounts WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY target_category, target_id, skill_id

SELECT target_category AS targetCategory, target_id AS targetId, skill_id AS skillId, enabled, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.skill_mounts WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY target_category, target_id, skill_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.skill_mounts (game_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, target_category, target_id, skill_id, enabled, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, #{skillId}, #{enabled}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, target_category, target_id, skill_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.skill_mounts_log (game_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, target_category, target_id, skill_id, enabled, extend) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, #{skillId}, #{enabled}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, target_category, target_id, skill_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
